title: 36 Hours: Austin, Tex.
abstract: Long a haven for free spirits, Austin these days is more chic than shabby.

title: 36 Hours in Austin, Tex.
abstract: New upscale restaurants and bars are popping up all over the city, but the old Austin isn’t hard to find.

title: 36 Hours: Tallinn, Estonia
abstract: While Old Town still trades on its medieval past, 21st-century attractions are coming to the fore in Estonia’s capital.

title: 36 Hours in Tallinn, Estonia
abstract: The Old Town still trades heavily on its medieval past but throughout the city a 21st-century vibe is becoming increasingly apparent.

title: 36 Hours: Long Beach, Calif.
abstract: Long Beach may have a gritty reputation, but its rough edges have been smoothed in recent years with a downtown waterfront transformed by museums and ethnic enclaves.

title: 36 Hours: Long Beach, Calif.
abstract: Explore Long Beach’s museums, restaurants, jazz clubs and vintage boutiques.

title: 36 Hours: Vientiane, Laos
abstract: Now is the time to explore this city’s small-town charms before it joins the modern world.

title: 36 Hours in Vientiane, Laos
abstract: Vientiane, with its gilded temples and colonial villas, is quickly changing. Visit now before it is enveloped by the modern world.

title: 36 Hours: Cologne, Germany
abstract: After crossing off bucket-list items like exploring the cathedral and crawling through legendary Kölsch pubs, focus on the city’s new shops, restaurants and hotels.
